messages:
julia: Quick sync — Q2 plan for API surface (function-calling, structured output, types). Need a minimal breaking approach + migration path. Customers (Acme, FinServe) pushed for stable typedefs and example code.

anya: +1. Avoid breaking hosted users. Suggest opt-in `structured_output` flag in v1 so clients can migrate.

samir: I like opt-in. Proposed phases:
- Phase 1: opt-in `structured_output` + backward-compatible `function_call` envelope, minimal SDK helpers.
- Phase 2: stricter typed responses, SDK type exports, deprecation notices for raw fields.

matt: Concrete launch criteria? My wishlist: security review, SDK PRs merged, e2e tests passing, docs + migration guide, 1 pilot customer.

liz: I can own docs. Need small, copy-paste examples for Python/TS showing parsing function calls and structured outputs. Draft snippets: 
```ts
export type FunctionCall = { name: string; arguments: Record<string, unknown>; };
```
```py
# example response shape
{"function_call": {"name": "foo", "arguments": {...}}}
```

anya: SDK plan (Python + TS): add optional typed helpers, keep runtime mapping for older responses, surface deprecation warnings in client logs, add clear changelog entries. Prototype = 2 sprints.

samir: Implementation notes from infra: additive header `X-Redwood-Structured: true` or query param, router will route to same model. Need tracing + token accounting for opt-in. Also add a compatibility layer that falls back when parse fails.

julia: Prioritization rubric suggestion: customer urgency 40%, engineering risk/effort 30%, docs/SDK effort 20%, strategic/revenue 10%. Acme scores high so should move up.

matt: Rollout plan: canary 5% hosted traffic, Dedicated customers opt-in, feature flag + automatic fallback if parse-error rate > 2% over 15m. Also require telemetry to verify cost/latency changes.

ci-bot: canary pipeline created: run/ci/canary-structured-output-v1 -> queued

liz: I'll draft migration guide: quickstart, how to detect parse failures, tests to assert backwards compatibility, and a deprecation timeline. Plan to request pilot signoff from Acme.

julia: Action items: @samir lead API patch, @anya lead SDK PRs, @liz own docs & migration guide, @matt coordinate pilot + signoff. Follow-up sync Friday 10am.

anya: noted — opening SDK tickets and will attach prototyping notes + examples.

samir: Opening draft PR today, will post link to thread when ready.
